name: Center
purpose: Center authored content or guarantee a centered square or circle without taking over paint, icon semantics, or positioned overlay layout.
useWhen: Content needs two-axis centering, or one fixed-size centered region must remain exactly square or circular under flex pressure.

avoidWhen.condition: Children follow a row or column relationship, only general constraints are needed, the region needs paint, or layers overlap.

composition: Use Center for arbitrary two-axis alignment. Use Square or Circle with a required size when equal geometry and fixed flex participation are part of the contract.
Compose Surface asChild around Square or Circle for background, boundary, elevation, or tone, and keep authored SVG sizing and accessibility on Icon.

rules.statement: Choose Center for arbitrary centering, Square for a guaranteed equal-size centered region, and Circle only when genuinely circular geometry is intended.
Give Square and Circle one explicit scalar or responsive size; do not recreate equal inline and block dimensions with separate Frame constraints.
Compose Surface or the purposeful finished owner for paint, padding, boundary, and elevation; Center, Square, and Circle own none of those jobs.
Keep SVG size, tone, direction, and accessibility on Icon; the centered container does not turn the graphic into an action or supply its meaning.
Use ZStack for positioned overlay centering; do not recreate AbsoluteCenter with application positioning or transforms.
Author responsive size mobile first; omit initial to keep automatic baseline geometry, or supply it to replace that baseline, and include only the Brick breakpoint overrides that change.
Load styles.css or core.css plus center.css.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using a shrinkable Frame/HStack icon well, adding background and radius to Icon, or using Circle for every decorative icon.
commonMistakes.correction: Use Square or Circle for invariant geometry, compose Surface for paint, and reserve Circle for deliberately circular presentation.

validation: Check computed centering, equal inline and block dimensions, fixed flex participation, responsive carry-forward, inline flow, RTL, and zoom.
Confirm Surface and Icon composition preserves paint, radius, glyph containment, and accessibility without custom layout CSS.
